post.description:
A generic text-generation interface to external LLM providers and Pryon-hosted LLMs.
 implements a subset of the OpenAI /v1/chat/completions API specification
 as defined here: https://platform.openai.com/docs/api-reference/chat
 Using the official OpenAI client SDK for your language is recommended.
 The following providers are supported currently:
 - pryon
 - openai
 - anthropic
 - vertex ai
 Please check the respective provider's documentation
 for supported text-generation models and accepted sampling params.
 If streaming is enabled, responses will follow the SSE standard
 https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/server-sent-events.html#server-sent-events.

get.description: Lists the models available for our Chat Completions API

post.description:
Generates a completed query by replacing references to entities / information
 in prior turns of the conversation.
Return query out-of-domain classifications given a query

displayName.description: Model name; for model selection on the Pryon platform.

models.description: Available models for the Chat Completions API; listed by provider.

messages.description: List of messages that form the conversation

model.description:
ID of the model to use, following the <provider>/<model_id> format.
 e.g pryon/pryon-zeus-1, openai/gpt-4o, openai/o1-mini,
 anthropic/claude-3-5-sonnet-latest etc.

temperature.description:
Sampling temperature.
 Range will depend on the specific model being called,
 Please check provider / model documentation.

topP.description: Alternative to temperature for nucleus sampling

stream.description: Whether to stream partial message deltas

stop.description: Stop sequences where the API should stop generating

maxCompletionTokens.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate

logprobs.description:
Whether to return log probabilities of the output tokens or not.
 If true, returns the log probabilities of each output token returned in the content of message.

topLogprobs.description:
An integer between 0 and 20 specifying the number of most likely tokens to return at each token position, each with an associated log probability.
 logprobs must be set to true if this parameter is used.

ChatCompletionsResponse.description:
Response for chat completion
 non-streaming: https://platform.openai.com/docs/api-reference/chat/object
 streaming: https://platform.openai.com/docs/api-reference/chat/streaming

id.description: Unique identifier for the chat completion

choices.description: A list of chat completion choices. Can be more than one if n is greater than 1.

created.description: The Unix timestamp (in seconds) of when the chat completion was created.

object.description:
The object type, which can be either
 chat.completion OR
 chat.completion.chunk

message.description:
The message containing the completion.
 Present only if stream=false in request.

delta.description:
The delta for a streaming chunk.
 Present only if stream=true in request.

logprobs.description: Log probability information for the choice.

conversationContext.description: Context for prior turns in the conversation.

conversationId.description:
Retrieve context history (question-answer pairs)
 from previous exchanges in the conversation.

Delta.description: Delta of a message for streaming

role.description: Role of the message sender (if changed)

GoogleProtobufAny.description: Contains an arbitrary serialized message along with a @type that describes the type of the serialized message.

ListChatCompletionsModelsRequest.description: The request schema for our ListChatCompletionsModels endpoint

ListChatCompletionsModelsResponse.description:
Response for ListChatCompletionsModels
 Provides all the available models for our Chat Completions API

items.description: Available models for the Chat Completions API; listed by provider.

logprob.description:
The log probability of this token, if it is within the top 20 most likely tokens.
 Otherwise, the value -9999.0 is used to signify that the token is very unlikely.

bytes.description:
A list of integers representing the UTF-8 bytes representation of the token.
 Useful in instances where characters are represented by multiple tokens
 and their byte representations must be combined to generate
 the correct text representation.
 Can be null if there is no bytes representation for the token.

A list of integers representing the UTF-8 bytes representation of the token.
 Useful in instances where characters are represented by multiple tokens
 and their byte representations must be combined to generate

topLogprobs.description:
List of the most likely tokens and their log probability, at this token position.
 In rare cases, there may be fewer than the number of requested top_logprobs returned.

content.description: A list of message content tokens with log probability information.

refusal.description: A list of message refusal tokens with log probability information.

role.description:
Role of the message sender (system, user, assistant)
 Please check provider documentation on what's supported
 for a particular model.

domain.description:
Modification to query classification prompt. Defaults to "the company you provide support for",
 but can be modified to define any domain, e.g. "a medical device manufacturer", "municipal public resources", etc.

enableGenerativeConversationalResponse.description: Whether or not conversational responses are generated or canned

isIntelligible.description: Whether or not the given query is intelligible

isEnglish.description: Whether or not the given query is in a supported language

isConversational.description: Whether or not the given query is conversational

conversationalResponse.description: The LLM-generated response if the query is indeed conversational

Status.description: The `Status` type defines a logical error model that is suitable for different programming environments, including REST APIs and RPC APIs. It is used by [gRPC](https://github.com/grpc). Each `Status` message contains three pieces of data: error code, error message, and error details. You can find out more about this error model and how to work with it in the [API Design Guide](https://cloud.google.com/apis/design/errors).

code.description: The status code; an enum value of the Google Remote Procedure Call (RPC).

message.description: Developer-facing error message; user-facing error messages are localized.
